module M
open Axial
open System.Threading.Tasks
let f () = flow { return raise (System.Exception()) }
let g () = System.DateTimeOffset.UtcNow
Findings: AXG001|Error|5:11-5:39|This call reads the ambient system clock through System.DateTimeOffset, which makes timing untestable. (1) Use Axial.IClock (Clock.now); add the Axial capability/service to your env. (2) If Axial has no service for this effect, create a service built on capabilities with 'axial add service <Name>'. (3) Only genuinely new raw I/O belongs in a capability under Capabilities/.

AXG003|Error|4:25-4:51|`raise` is called directly inside a `flow { }` block. Flow already has a typed 'error channel for expected failures - an ordinary exception here silently becomes a defect (Cause.Die) instead, which callers matching on 'error never see. Replace it with `return! Flow.fail err` for an expected failure, or `return! Flow.die defect` for an unrecoverable defect.
